subject.title: fix: guard JSON.parse calls against malformed external responses

question: Should the OpenRouter malformed-frame parse guard land through this PR first, be folded into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101488, or be split away before either branch lands?
rationale: The code is correct, but two open OpenRouter stream branches touch the same reader and the newer stream-caps branch currently does not include this malformed JSON guard.

options.title: Land This Guard First
options.body: Merge or rebase this PR as the canonical parse-hardening branch, then require the OpenRouter stream-caps branch to preserve the malformed-frame guard.

options.title: Fold Into Stream Caps
options.body: Ask the OpenRouter stream-caps branch to include this malformed-frame guard and then narrow this PR to the docs and Claude MCP fixes before merge.

options.title: Split The OpenRouter Hunk
options.body: Keep this PR for docs and Claude MCP only while maintainers decide the OpenRouter stream parser direction separately.

recommendation.title: Land This Guard First
recommendation.body: Merge or rebase this PR as the canonical parse-hardening branch, then require the OpenRouter stream-caps branch to preserve the malformed-frame guard.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the best available product/code owner for coordinating docs CLI, music generation, and bundle MCP behavior across the overlapping branches.
